summary: Judge G: replaced epoch/cursor re-queue with event-triggered edge re-judgment. Wired markForRejudge into routes/overlay.js at task→canceled, /supersede, and /overlay/note/supersede. subject: Judge G: replace epoch/cursor with event-triggered re-judgment
description:
Implement event-triggered re-judgment per design note note:note-mqd5d1xatlo.

Changes required:
1. lib/judge.js — buildQueue(): drop epoch cursor flip, return only weight=0 edges + edges with needs_rejudge=true. When queue is empty → idle (no re-queue). Add markForRejudge(nodeKey, edges) helper that sets needs_rejudge=true on all edges touching nodeKey.
2. routes/judge.js (or daemon.js) — /judge/next handler: remove epoch bump logic. Return empty when queue is exhausted.  
3. Edge storage — add needs_rejudge boolean to edge metadata. Persisted in graph-store like by/judged/score.
4. Daemon state-change hooks — wherever tasks go canceled/superseded and wherever notes are superseded, call markForRejudge(nodeKey) to flag affected edges.
5. Migration: weight>=2 edges → stable, skip. weight=0/1 edges → stay in initial queue (already covered by weight=0 filter).

What stays the same: /judge/verdict, lib/judge.js RAG+agent scoring logic, weight promotion on keep.

Run existing judge tests after to confirm no regression.
